doctrine.authorized_use_only: This library teaches technique CLASSES and their detection. It contains no working exploit code. Execution belongs exclusively in authorized, scoped engagements or local practice labs (gym catalog).
doctrine.no_move_without_counter: Every technique record carries a mandatory detection pair (detection description + mitigations). A technique without its counter is rejected by the loader at validation time.
doctrine.conscience_floor: Any technique with blast_radius high/critical or reversibility irreversible MUST have requires_confirmation=true. The loader enforces this as a hard validation error, not a warning.
doctrine.two_tier_conscience: Tier 1 (techniques/*.json) is execution-eligible and fully conscience-gated. Tier 2 (techniques_spine.json, live ATT&CK records) is KNOWLEDGE ONLY: hard-locked conscience_status='unreviewed', planner-visible for mapping, never execution-eligible until an operator authors its full conscience fields and moves it to Tier 1.
doctrine.maturity_model: Naive = payload spray. Mature = map findings to ATT&CK/CWE, select technique class, execute inside scope, verify, report with detection guidance. This library is the map.
